title: A Fordham hadith selection quotes Aisha: small regular deeds are the most loved
summary: Fordham's selection quotes a hadith: the deeds most loved by God are regular ones, even if small.
body: Fordham's hadith page quotes Aisha as reporting that the deeds most loved by Allah are those done regularly, even if small, and it cites Bukhari and Muslim. The page is a selection, not a critical edition of the isnad. The card records the selection's wording. The wording on the page includes: "Collection of Al-Hadiths Hadeeth: (1). 'A'isha said that Rasulullah saw said : "The deeds most loved by Allah swt (are those) done regularly, even if they are small". ( Bukhari, Muslim ) (2). 'Abdullah b. Umar said that Rasulullah saw said : "The muslim is he from whose tongue and hand a Muslim is safe, and the muhajir he who gives up what Allah has prohibited for". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
